g.title: G
g.text: Cultures BEFORE the first dose · culture 24–48 h · PCN allergy 10% report / 1% true · vanco trough right before the next dose · oseltamivir ≤ 48 h

g.title: core
g.text: right bug · reaches the site · beats resistance · fits the patient

g.title: resist
g.text: inactivation · target alteration · reduced entry · efflux
the bacteria become resistant, not the patient

g.title: fungi
g.text: ampho B: cidal · chills, kidneys, ↓ K⁺/Mg²⁺

g.title: virus
g.text: within 48 h · flu only · not a vaccine

g.title: wall
g.text: β-lactamase cleaves the ring · MRSA = altered PBPs

g.title: ribo
g.text: doxy: water, upright 30 min, minerals, sun, not < 7

g.title: dna
g.text: TMP-SMX: K⁺, sulfa, SJS, fluids, INR

g.title: pcn
g.text: allergy: clarify; all PCNs + some ceph cross

g.title: carba
g.text: imipenem/cilastatin: broadest, not MRSA, ↓ valproic acid → seizures

g.title: nurse
g.text: on schedule · watch diarrhea (C. diff), superinfection
take as prescribed · never save or share

g.title: ribo2
g.text: linezolid: MRSA/VRE · SSRIs → serotonin syndrome · platelets
